reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) supports the formation of sigma precipitates and their role in enhancing yield strength, but provides no data or discussion on oxidation resistance, corrosion resistance, or a dissolution temperature of ~900 °C. The oxidation/corrosion and thermal stability premises are therefore unsupported.
premises: Co or Ni additions to Al0.8NbTiV form homogeneously distributed sigma precipitates
Sigma precipitates improve yield strength via dislocation pinning
